mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_progress (user_id, topic_id, status, last_studied_at, last_reviewed_at, review_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topicId}, #{status}, #{lastStudiedAt}, #{lastReviewedAt}, #{reviewCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM topic_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.update: UPDATE topic_progress SET status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), last_studied_at = COALESCE(#{lastStudiedAt}, last_studied_at), last_reviewed_at = COALESCE(#{lastReviewedAt}, last_reviewed_at) , review_count = review_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
